content: Anthropic Claude API (platform.claude.com docs, primary source): 'Retained data is never used for model training without your express permission.' Zero data retention is available for /v1/messages and most core endpoints; some tool features (code execution containers) are ZDR-ineligible with up to 30-day retention. Standard commercial log retention was reduced from 30 to 7 days in Sept 2025 (secondary sources; not confirmed on the primary page fetched).
